title: Backend Integration Door
description: The backend module documentation on the single Rust interface point.
body: This app's one and only door to Rust. Kept out of ./index.ts on purpose: that module is imported by a plain-Node unit test, and @openkaava/bridge's root export touches window at module load. ./backend.ts is the only file in this app that contains invoke — a new operation gets a new function here, never a new file.
